title: Mutate Behind Sharing
goal: A shared list that still accepts pushes - interior mutability, borrowed correctly on both sides.
hints: Rc alone shares immutably. RefCell is the layer that sells write passes - one at a time, checked at runtime.
snapshot returns a Vec - cloning the RefCell wrapper instead of the Vec inside it produces the wrong type.
explanation: Rc<RefCell<T>> is the classic shared-mutable pairing: Rc counts owners, RefCell enforces one-writer-XOR-many-readers at RUNTIME. add_score needs the exclusive write pass - borrow_mut(); a read pass can't push (E0596 through the Ref), and no pass at all leaves you talking to the RefCell wrapper (no push there, E0599). On the reading side, borrow().clone() copies the Vec out; skipping the borrow clones the RefCell itself - wrong type, E0308. The mutation flows to the other handle instantly: one Vec, counted owners, disciplined access.
